user.title: Find a stop
user.description: Search for a Translink bus or rail stop by name (e.g. "Cambria Street"). Each direction is usually a separate stop.

services.title: Services at {stop}
services.description: Optionally only show some services. Seen at this stop right now: {seen}. Leave empty for all; you can also type a service that isn't running at the moment.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Translink. Try again in a moment.

abort.already_configured: This stop is already set up.

get_departures.name: Get departures
get_departures.description: Returns upcoming (non-cancelled) departures for a stop.

start.name: From
start.description: Return departures from this time instead of now (future only).

invalid_config_entry.message: That isn't a Translink NI stop.

entry_not_loaded.message: That Translink stop isn't currently loaded.
